items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Well, that's where he took the name from. That's from Freddie Keppard.

ctx.x: Olympia. Because I know one time people tell me Freddie Keppard had a band with.
Well, that's where he took the name from. That's from Freddie Keppard.
Did Ricard Alexis play trumpet with you at that time? I think he told me he played once in the Young Olympia Band or something.
